claims.statement: Company expects steady growth in next fiscal year as market conditions improve
Export revenue stood at Rs 460 crore for FY24
Plans to establish a greenfield facility near Chennai in Southern India
Operates 8 manufacturing units across 5 locations as of FY24
Management targets a return to long-term growth trend in FY25, ambition of 10-15% revenue growth
FY25 capex budget broadly in line with previous year, more than INR100 crore including Chennai plant and brownfield expansions
Chennai greenfield facility on long-term lease near Chennai, hopes to start this calendar year and certainly this financial year
Chennai plant is one line out of ~20 lines company-wide, revenue impact expected from next financial year
Overall capacity utilization approximately 75% to 80%
Flexible packaging utilization still low after new line added mid-late last year, no major capex planned for next year
Q4 margin improvement driven largely by raw material price decline and product mix improvement
Management expects to continue high double-digit top-line growth in FY25 with a healthy mix of value and volume.
Management hopes to maintain EBITDA margins in the 17-18% range if the environment remains stable.
Total capex for FY25 expected to exceed Rs. 100 crore, including the Chennai greenfield plant and other equipment.
Chennai greenfield mono-carton plant expected to commission in Q3 FY25 (by Diwali), adding ~5% to total capacity.
Paperboard segment utilization at 70%+; flexible packaging at 50-60% due to new line absorption.
Peak utilization of 80-90% achievable for paperboard; flexible packaging has long way to go.
Q1 FY25 EBITDA margin improved 108 bps YoY to 17.6% driven by better mix, operating leverage, and cost management.
Chennai plant will have negative margin impact in first year due to unabsorbed overheads.
Greenfield facility near Chennai on track to be commissioned in coming months
Production facility expected to reach optimal levels within 9 to 12 months following commissioning
Chennai greenfield facility expected to commence in one to two months, then ramp up over a few months
Chennai plant will add about 750 tonnes per month of board conversion capacity, translating to Rs 70-80 crore annual revenue initially
Annual capex plan of over Rs 100 crore for incremental capacity, land acquisition, brownfield expansion and larger projects
Raw material price decline over the past six to nine months benefited margins, but prices are now flat with only marginal moves
Flexible packaging plant has 30-40% extra capacity underutilized; folding carton utilization was around 80% before new Goa line and Chennai plant
Subsidiary COPPL has entered many clients, stabilized with a couple of big clients, and expects anchor customers to grow after strong pre-Diwali performance
Greenfield facility near Chennai for paperboard cartons to be commissioned in current quarter
Management targets long-term average growth rate but does not provide specific guidance
EBITDA margins steady at 15% in Q3 FY25; flexible packaging growth may slightly reduce blended margin but similar return on capital
Creative Offset subsidiary expected to do about Rs. 50 crore revenue this year with high double-digit growth next year
FY25 capex spend about Rs. 150 crore; FY26 budget not finalized as projects still in planning stage
Overall capacity utilization at 80% plus; Chennai greenfield adds less than 10% capacity with room for further expansion
Gravure cylinder facility commissioning targeted by Q3 FY2026 with annual capacity of ~12,000 cylinders
Greenfield plant near Chennai inaugurated for high-quality paperboard carton production
Export growth expected to continue positive long-term trajectory but percentage growth harder to sustain on larger base
Domestic business expected to improve in FY26 driven by new Chennai plant and customer developments
Creative Offset Printers expected to grow faster than last year and turn around to positively contribute to bottom line
FY25 capex was Rs. 150 crore with Rs. 50 crore under work in progress to be commissioned in current year
FY26 capex expected to be lower and moderate with no major greenfield projects planned
Gravure cylinder manufacturing facility with 12,000 cylinders annual capacity to be commissioned by Q3 FY26
Chennai Greenfield facility for paperboard cartons inaugurated, phased ramp-up expected over 6-12 months
Overall company utilization around 70-75%, Innofilms utilization at 60-70%
EBITDA margins historically average 15-17% quarterly, no dramatic change expected
Export enquiries and developments in pipeline, timing uncertain but long-term trajectory positive
Chennai greenfield plant ramping up within FY26
Chennai greenfield plant operational, focusing on sustainable paperboard cartons
Management targets mid-teens to high-teens revenue CAGR over the long term.
Annual capex typically Rs 100-150 crore; no further capex planned for Chennai plant this year.
Chennai greenfield facility achieved production stability in Q1 FY26; goal to fill first line this financial year.
Consolidated capacity utilization around 70% in Q1 FY26.
Q1 FY26 EBITDA margin 17.1%, down 50 bps YoY due to higher fixed and variable costs and lower revenue growth.
Chennai Greenfield plant newly commissioned and ramping up well
EBITDA margins were 15% in Q2 and 16% in H1 FY26; management expects margins to normalize in coming quarters with no significant change in operating conditions.
Gross margin pressure of ~200 bps sequentially attributed to inventory fluctuations and slight raw material price increase, not a major factor.
INR 100+ crore capex budgeted for FY26, over half already spent; includes land, building for future expansion, new cylinder factory commissioning this quarter, balancing and specialty equipment.
Carton business at ~70% overall utilization with room for top-line growth; flexible packaging has free capacity, no immediate capex planned except balancing equipment and building expansion.
Chennai Greenfield plant ramping up well at 40-50% utilization; large account approvals progressing; expects good utilization over next few quarters.
Aspiration for mid-double-digit top-line growth with better bottom-line improvement; both carton and flexible packaging to grow at similar rates, flexibles faster from lower base.
Commissioned gravure cylinder manufacturing facility at Silvassa in Q3 FY26 under subsidiary Accura Technik Private Limited
Consolidated EBITDA increased ~15% YoY to INR 81 crore; margins expanded to 17.2%, up ~240 bps, driven by better gross margins from favourable product mix and tighter cost control.
Capex for FY27 estimated at about INR 100 crore, similar to FY26; FY25 capex was ~INR 150 crore.
Chennai plant utilisation below 50%, expected to improve in next few months; overall utilisation ~70-75%, flexible packaging slightly higher.
Domestic demand expected to remain healthy and be key growth driver, supported by policy measures; export sentiment improving due to trade developments with EU and US.
Commitment to achieve carbon neutrality for Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions
Expect improved export momentum in coming year as market conditions normalise
FY27 capex expected around INR 100 crore, similar to last year, with flexibility to expand faster if market conditions require
Capex focused on flexible packaging due to high utilization; carton segment has double-digit growth scope in current capacity; expanding factory areas in some plants for future expansion

Chennai greenfield facility over 50% utilized with positive outlook and recent customer approvals; Noida facility improved and expected to improve further; flexible packaging plants well-utilized with last commercialized line at optimum lev

Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin 17.4% including forex gains; full year margin 17.3%; impacted by elevated RM costs and timing lag in passing on cost inflation; focused on calibrated pricing, mix improvement, and operating efficiencies for margin impr
Q1 FY27 consolidated total income grew 16% YoY to INR 495 crore; EBITDA grew 17% to INR 88 crore with margins at 18%; cash profit up 56% to INR 76 crore; PAT up 79% to INR 40 crore
EBITDA margin improved to 18% in Q1 FY27; management expects margins to follow top line and maintain good profile, but no structural margin expansion or contraction signaled
FY27 non-separator capex budget ~INR 100 crore; separator project ~INR 125 crore over 18 months (INR 30-40 crore in FY27); flexible packaging expansion ~INR 50-60 crore for 30% capacity increase

Flexible packaging facility at optimal utilization; adding high-speed line for ~30% capacity increase, operational by Jan-Feb 2026; folding cartons at ~70% utilization with headroom varying by plant; Chennai plant ramp-up on track
Broad-based growth across domestic and export; flexible packaging growing faster; Chennai plant utilization improving toward 70%
Management aims to maintain historical revenue growth trajectory but does not provide specific guidance
EBITDA margin improved ~100 bps YoY to 17.7% in Q2 FY27 driven by pricing actions, favourable product mix and operating leverage
Export performance satisfactory with growth; export inquiries and interest ramping up
Incorporated TCPL Energy Materials Limited for lithium-ion battery separator films; Phase 1 investment targeting up to INR 200 crore revenue potential
Chennai facility utilization steadily improving; may add another line sometime next year
